}} The '''Indoor Palm''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|600}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}. It can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|summer}}. Two are obtained when the [[Farmhouse|Bedroom]] is redecorated by [[Penny]] in her [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event, choosing Pirate Theme. Four can be found in the repaired [[Island Farmhouse]]. ==Trivia== * As of [[Version History#1.5|version 1.5]], the name "Indoor Palm" is a misnomer - it can be placed indoors or outdoors. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Updated sprite.
